page headline. It is separate from the gallery list, so include it in
"gallery" too if you also want it clickable.
The gallery is a column masonry layout, so portrait and landscape photos
both display uncropped at their natural shape. No orientation flag needed.
Until at least one photo is listed, the page falls back to the storefront
image and the gallery section hides itself entirely.
prevent layout shift while images load), caption (optional, shown on hover
